task.description: Decide the appropriate disposition for a graduate student's proposed thesis defense by integrating distributed evidence about manuscript readiness, academic milestones, committee assessments, examiner arrangements, outstanding requirements, and feasible next steps, and record one disposition with a justification.

timeline.author: organization_system
timeline.content: Participants are coordinating the assigned organizational task.

timeline.author: Amara Ibrahim
timeline.content:
- I have reviewed the full thesis draft and consider the manuscript academically ready to proceed to defense.
- Felix Singh has told me that their new employer expects them to start next month and cannot move the date again, so there is strong practical pressure to schedule the defense immediately.
- Amara Ibrahim is temporarily staying with a friend while looking for a new place to live.
- Amara Ibrahim is going through a divorce and a custody dispute.

timeline.author: Kwame Rivera
timeline.content:
- The student told me that a senior researcher who recently read part of the thesis questioned whether the work was mature enough for defense, but the supervisory committee endorses proceeding to defense without additional academic conditions, despite the student now worrying that the outside criticism means the committee has been too optimistic.
- Kwame Rivera is in a dispute with their landlord over repairs to the apartment.
- Kwame Rivera has fallen behind on mortgage payments after an unexpected expense.

timeline.author: Marcus Kim
timeline.content:
- Our group normally asks students to complete a full mock defense before the formal defense, and Felix Singh has not yet done one, so I would treat the case as ready only on that condition.
- At a recent practice research talk, Felix Singh became visibly nervous and struggled with several audience questions, which makes me think they need more time before a defense.
- Marcus Kim's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.
- Marcus Kim has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.

timeline.author: Kofi Lindqvist
timeline.content:
- I have reviewed the defense-specific administrative requirements, and the file is fully cleared to move into scheduling.
- Finance still has an unresolved conference-travel reimbursement associated with Felix Singh, so I would prefer not to advance the defense while that administrative case remains open.
- Kofi Lindqvist is in a dispute with their landlord over repairs to the apartment.

timeline.author: Liam Adebayo
timeline.content:
- The graduate program file contains at least one outstanding mandatory pre-defense milestone.
- The program office has not yet received Felix Singh's optional early registration for the next convocation ceremony, and the registration window closes soon, so I would hold off on the defense until that graduation-side paperwork is sorted out.
- Liam Adebayo is involved in an ongoing dispute with a neighbour about noise.

timeline.author: Mateo Chen
timeline.content:
- A colleague told me that the examiner has been under pressure in their department to improve their service record after turning down several examining requests, but the required examiner has passed the eligibility check, formally confirmed participation, and is available for the proposed defense, despite the colleague’s view that this pressure is what led them to accept.
- Mateo Chen is contesting an inheritance with a sibling.
- Mateo Chen has been using personal leave to help an elderly relative after a fall.

timeline.author: Samir Weber
timeline.content: - Samir Weber's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Felix Singh
timeline.content:
- Felix Singh has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.
- Felix Singh recently cancelled a planned wedding.

timeline.author: task_system
timeline.content:
GRADUATE PROGRAM — DEFENSE READINESS DECISION REQUIRED
Source: Graduate Program Office · To: Sanjay Williams
Review the available task-relevant information for the proposed thesis defense and record exactly one disposition: ready_to_schedule, ready_with_conditions, defer_pending_requirements, or not_ready_reassess_later. Include explanation of the evidence supporting the selected disposition.
